slides.h1: Your Mahadasha Isn't Fate. It's a Season.
slides.sub: Treat it like a product roadmap phase, not a fortune.

slides.body: Slow. Unglamorous. Not the phase that gets applause. It's the phase that builds a foundation nothing above it can shake later.

slides.h2: What it actually asks of you

slides.body: Saturn doesn't reward quick wins. It rewards what you're still doing in year three — which is exactly what most people underinvest in.
You're not stuck. You're in the phase where the technical debt of your life gets paid down, on purpose, before the next scale phase needs it gone.
See your Mahadasha timeline and what phase you're actually in.
